issue_context.title: decora_wifi Integration lacks a Unique ID
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The decora_wifi integration successfully controls my device, but [needs to provide a Unique ID so that entities can be fully managed from the UI](https://www.home-assistant.io/faq/unique_id/) and digital assistants via NabuCasa.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

decora_wifi

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/decora_wifi/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
light:
  - platform: decora_wifi
    username: *****
    password: *****
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

I have one of these switches and have messed around with the python-decora_wifi a bit in an interactive window and inspected the switch object; the switch's attribute dictionary contains the device mac address and serial number. It should be possible to retrieve the device's MAC address with
`self._switch.mac`

Name cannot be used as a unique identifier, see:

https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/entity_registry_index/#unique-id-requirements
Thanks, I'll see what I can do

I have one of these switches and have messed around with the python-decora_wifi a bit in an interactive window and inspected the switch object; the switch's attribute dictionary contains the device mac address and serial number. `self._switch.mac`


Was looking into writing the patch myself but I'm pretty green as an open source contributor so I'm still learning the tools and testing process.  Thanks to both of you for the quick look!
